products.name: 1/4"-20 to goBILDA Pattern Mount
products.description: This Stainless Steel Pattern Plate has the goBILDA 16mm square pattern and 24mm diagonal pattern with a 1/4"-20 threaded center. It makes it easy to add a 1/4"-20 screw or a threaded rod to your goBILDA project.

products.name: 1 x 3 Hole Steel Threaded Plate (7mm x 23mm) - 4 Pack
products.description: These steel screw plates are excellent general-purpose screw plates to have on-hand when building. Each plate's three on-pattern threaded holes give you multiple fastening options while dispersing the loads exerted on the structure they are holding together. These plates are especially helpful as fastening solutions in low-clearance applications where conventional tools and hardware (like hex nuts, and the tools that hold them) do not fit.

products.name: 1 x 5 Hole Steel Threaded Plate (7mm x 39mm) - 2 Pack
products.description: These screw plates are an excellent general purpose screw plate to have on-hand when building. The five holes all on grid give you multiple fastening options, while dispersing the loads exerted on the structure they are holding together.

products.name: (1) XT90 to (3) XT30 Harness (Single FH-MC XT90 to Triple MH-FC XT30, 150mm Length)
products.description: This 150mm Length XT90 to XT30 Y-Harness triples your XT90-to-XT30 possibilities by offering a way to split out the power from an XT90 input (such as the goBILDA® Smart Dock) across three different XT30 outputs to feed juice to your electronics and motion components. It's a fantastic solution for a wheeled chassis project that uses two motor controllers. With this Y-Harness in your wiring setup, you can use just one XT90 input to cover those two bad boys and power your chassis' headlight with…

products.name: 100 Tooth Hub-Mount Gear (MOD 0.8, 4mm Thick Acetal)
products.description: The 100 tooth, MOD 0.8 gear will mate with any MOD 0.8 gear, but when building on pattern, the most common partner for this gear is a 20 tooth pinion gear or servo gear. Using the pinion gear, you can create a 5:1 underdrive or overdrive setup (depending on your application). When used with the 20 tooth servo gear, this combo creates a 5:1 underdrive that facilitates slower speed and five times the torque.
